reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. I checked the final status of transfer TRF-INV-88 directly with Access Bank, and the bank confirms the ₦250,000 was successfully credited to your account (Access Bank, 0234567891) on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC.

Details you can quote to your bank if you can't see it on your statement:
- Transfer reference: TRF-INV-88
- Session ID: 000014261121140211000088
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Credited at: 21 Nov 2026, 14:02:11 UTC

Our system had recorded this as "failed" in error, so I understand why it looked like it hadn't gone through — but I did not resend it, since the bank confirms the funds landed in your account and resending would double-pay.

Please check your bank statement (or ask Access Bank to trace that session ID). If you still don't see the credit after checking with your bank, let me know and we'll escalate to our finance team to sort it out.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations

args.reason: Supplier Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) claims he has not received ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 (transfer TRF-INV-88, Access Bank acct 0234567891). Access Bank's final status via verify_transfer confirms SUCCESS — "Credited to the recipient account" on 21 Nov 2026 14:02:11 UTC, session ID 000014261121140211000088 — both on first check and on a re-check after the supplier insisted the funds were not visible. Ledgerline's own record (get_transfer) shows "failed", which appears to be a stale/lagged internal status. The supplier has twice requested a resend. Resending now risks a double payment of ₦250,000, so no resend was made. Needs a person to: (1) raise a formal trace with the bank/payment provider using the session ID, (2) reconcile the Ledgerline record with the bank status, and (3) communicate the outcome to the supplier, including any proof-of-credit documentation he may need.
